test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 14 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

John ran pretty fast, _______ he did not win the race.
solution:
The correct answer is **'though'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **'Though'** is used to indicate that the information in a clause contrasts with the other part of the sentence.
 
• Here **'though'** is the most appropriate choice as it shows the contrast between the first clause 'John ran pretty fast'&
